note: Generated by scripts/generate-catalogue.mjs from the meta/ sidecars and the classes — do not edit by hand; run `npm run catalogue` (AGENTS.md §7).
role: step 2 of 3 — the control reference: every in-scope UI5 demo kit sample rebuilt 1:1 as an abap2UI5 class. Learn the patterns in abap2UI5/samples first; what needs your system (OData, RAP, APC, the launchpad) is in abap2UI5/samples-stack.
caveat: Class names: this repository uses the Z2UI5_CL_SMPC_* prefix, abap2UI5/samples uses Z2UI5_CL_SMP_* — one character apart, with INDEPENDENT numbering. z2ui5_cl_smp_app_042 and z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_042 are unrelated samples: match on the full class name, never on the number or a fuzzy prefix.
